repos_data.description: ⚡ Professional Golang SDK for Bybit V5 API. Lightning-fast trading with real-time WebSocket streams, complete REST API coverage, and production-ready features. Supports spot & derivatives trading, HMAC/RSA authentication, multi-region endpoints, and advanced order types with TP/SL. Goroutine-safe, testnet-ready, zero dependencies. 🚀

Unofficial Go SDK for the Glassnode Basic API. Dependency-light, idiomatic client covering 25 metric categories with typed structs, context propagation, automatic 429 retry, API key redaction, and runtime metadata discovery. Built for production dashboards and backtesting pipelines that need reliable on-chain data access.

A lightweight, dependency-free Golang client for the Nansen AI API. Context-aware, concurrency-safe, and fully typed, with functional options, automatic retries and exponential backoff on rate limits, and rich, typed error handling. Covers Smart Money, Token God Mode, Profiler, Portfolio, and historical backtesting endpoints.
